Name: Project Windstorm
Overview:
Project Windstorm is an arcade-like style paratrooper game which takes place in the sky amongst clouds, planes, and other hazards which must be approached differently.

In the game you take control of a paratrooper and are tasked with completing mission specific objectives.

This game features falling out of planes, guns, missiles, explosions, humour, witty dialogue but thankfully no car chases.
